text: いっぱい　なら　つぎに　あった　ときまで　とって　おくね

structure.jp: つぎに　あった　ときまで
structure.en: until the time we next meet
I'll keep it aside for you

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is how things are'. いっぱい なら = 'if it's full'.

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ておく after a verb says you do it now so it is ready for later. とって おく = 'I'll keep it aside'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a noun describes that noun. つぎに あった とき = 'the time when we next meet'.
